name: laurent_x_dubois
description: Laurent Dubois's portfolio website for photography

scripts.dev: npm run build:manifest && concurrently -n "scss,worker" -c "magenta,cyan" "sass --watch scss:public/css" "wrangler dev"
scripts.dev:node: npm run build:manifest && concurrently -n "scss,server" -c "magenta,blue" "sass --watch scss:public/css" "nodemon --ext js,json,ejs,html,scss,jpg,png server.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:manifest && npm run build:css && npm run build:sitemap

author: Michael Lohier
